messages:
mina: Quick heads-up — aiming to roll engine v2.14 + QuantProfile-B on Tue 03:00 UTC. This will include the new kernel runtime and a small kv-cache invalidation. Need to align on: quiet window, DB migrations, who runs smoke checks, and rollback tag.
raf: I can own ops handoff and rollback verification. Does the rollout require any DB change?
yasmin: No schema migrations. We do need a short redis key flush for the prefix we changed (kv:runtime-prefix). Planning to coord that during the quiet window.
mina: Good — so no DB migrations. Raf, can you run the rollback smoke after the first canary slice? I want a quick verification checklist.
raf: Yep. My checklist: 1) canary slice at 1% 2) verify p95 tokens < 120ms and error rate < 0.3% 3) run synthetic prompts against pinned model 4) validate kv cache warmup. If any fail, roll back to engine v2.13.
julian: For (3) I'll push a small preflight harness with 50 requests against the exact prompt set used in last regression test. Will post PR in a few mins.
yasmin: Also: kv cache invalidation command — run this after canary spin-up, before traffic increase:
```
# flush kv cache for runtime prefix
redis-cli -h redis.prod -n 6 --scan --pattern "kv:runtime-prefix:*" | xargs -L 100 redis-cli -h redis.prod -n 6 del
```
Please run only once, and don't run during model warmup or we'll spike load.
mina: Noted. Who's oncall for that slot? Sam?
sam-oncall: I'm oncall that window. I'll monitor infra and tail the engine logs. Give me the smoke checklist and I'll ack.
raf: I'm toggling a quiet window: Tue 02:50–04:30 UTC. Will add a short 'no-noncritical deploys' note to the calendar.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment window: 2026-03-24 02:50–04:30 UTC (engine v2.14). Canary slices: 1%, 10%, 50% -> auto-promote on passing checks when p95 latency & error thresholds met.
yasmin: Small compatibility note — quant profile B can increase memory pressure by ~6% on T4. We should watch OOM counts on the first hour.
julian: I added PR 4829: preflight harness + smoke runner. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/4829 (comments: run with --canary).
mina: Great. Raf to own rollback, Sam to monitor logs, Julian to run preflight, Yasmin to coordinate kv flush, Mina to signal go/no-go. If anything unexpected, we tag rollback:v2.13. Make sure the rollback document is pinned in the thread.
raf: Quick note on rollback — I prepared the rollback command set:
```
# rollback to engine v2.13
kubectl set image deployment/engine engine=registry.redwood/engine:v2.13 --namespace=prod
# invalidate quant-specific caches
curl -X POST https://control.redwood/internal/flush_quant_cache -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```
I'll paste in runbook section and test commands in the thread.
sam-oncall: A couple of alerts to watch: engine_memory_oom, kv_miss_spike, p95_latency_regress. I'll create dashboard pins.
mina: Thanks team. I'll do final go/no-go 30m before window. If no objections, proceed. :thumbsup:
raf: ACK.
julian: ACK, will be standing by.
yasmin: ACK — will wait for the canary green before flush.
sam-oncall: ACK — monitoring on my side.
deploy-bot: Deployment hooks enabled: preflight-runner, canary-promote, rollback-trigger. Logs will stream to #eng-runtime-deploys.
